title: Local validation and the unseen supplier
application: Identify the decision the tests left uncovered, the dependency that remained opaque and the authority that could suspend the operation.
boundary: Judge local tests against the decision and dependencies they were designed to cover.

title: Workforce planning and luxury shifts
application: Before choosing an algorithm, distinguish the documented rule, the mandate still to be issued and any group or shift that must stay together.
boundary: The xSeil comparison offers an allocation mechanism to examine in the workforce context.

title: Recommendations in luxury retail
application: Retrieve similar candidates, then check the market, validity period, stock and right to make an offer.
boundary: Commercial authority depends on the actual market and offer.

title: Application rationalization
application: Identify which capability an application supports, who still needs it and how to preserve it when the technology is retired.
boundary: Retirement decisions need evidence about capability and dependency alongside usage and cost.

title: Human intelligence debt
application: Separate necessary work, original information and avoidable compensation. Measure the capacity that returns to useful work after handover.
boundary: Measure realized recovery over a stated period.

title: The cost of clarity and the act of declaring
application: Identify whether an open question needs more evidence or a decision by the authority that can settle it.
boundary: Make provisional decisions reversible and state who can commit the operation.

title: Tiger Teams as intervention architecture
application: Connect the mandate to field capabilities, a response in production and a transfer that the receiving team can carry forward.
boundary: Assess the intervention against the mission and the receiving team's ability to continue the work.

title: Suppliers and the timing of evidence
application: Reconstruct what was known on each date, what later corrections changed and which source supported each decision.
boundary: Use separate evidence for the historical case and for any formal mechanism transferred from it.

title: Robotics and cross-border mobility
application: Give each interface a state, a meaning, a responsible owner and an expiry condition. Specify how the receiver detects a change of context.
boundary: Use the route as a design proposal to test in the receiving setting.

title: From a foundation to a test contract
application: Turn a principle into requirements, measures, comparators and conditions that could disprove it. State the evidence behind the conclusion.
boundary: Record formal results, simulation and operating evidence as separate stages.

title: Silent failures and sufficient control
application: Compare signal timing, time to understand, decision authority and the burden of containment before automating a response.
boundary: Use a stress case to specify what an operating detector would need to demonstrate.

title: From the corpus to collaborators and public AI
application: Publish definitions and links, teach through difficult decisions, invite external criticism and track versions and corrections.
boundary: Evaluate discoverability, understanding and independent validation separately.
